added: Documentation site regenerated with a detailed, authored-content layer: per-feature pages, a Skills section, a Dependencies & Integrations catalog, and this Changelog.
New wiki-generator extractors: features, skills, dependencies, integrations, and changelog.
Callout blurbs (tip / note / warning / important) rendered throughout the site.

Markdown docs now render under their own navSection path (e.g. /roadmap) instead of a single generic /docs bucket.
The wiki authoring model uses the Anthropic-backed `documentation` alias on the LiteLLM gateway.
fixed: wiki-generate-reusable.yml is valid YAML again (the commit-message block scalar was terminated by unindented lines).
The API sandbox template no longer breaks `tsc` for repos without a backend proxy.

Shared e2e-pipeline-reusable workflow and shared dev skills (code-audit, postman-management, android-conventions).
